title: Fathom Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Nasdaq notified Fathom Holdings Inc. (FTHM) on April 10, 2026 that the company's stock price had fallen below the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market, triggering a 180-day compliance period ending October 7, 2026.
key_points: Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2) requires minimum $1.00 bid price for continued listing
Company has until October 7, 2026 to regain compliance
Compliance achieved if bid price closes at $1.00+ for minimum of 10 consecutive business days
An additional 180-day compliance period may be available if initial period expires without compliance
Notice has no immediate effect; trading continues under symbol FTHM on Nasdaq Capital Market
Company is evaluating options but there is no assurance of compliance
